Neon developer preview. Review this draft and its source CI evidence before publishing.

- **Neon.zip:** native macOS build, ad-hoc signed; not notarized.
- **Neon-Simulator.zip:** iPhone/iPad Simulator build; not a device-installable IPA.
- **SHA256SUMS / provenance.json:** package checksums, exact source commit, and CI run.

Document recovery, complete accessibility/device acceptance, and production distribution
remain release prerequisites. Keep independent backups of important manuscripts.
This preview is not a production-readiness or physical-device validation claim.
